updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Expands to Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is extending to Microsoft Cowork, allowing administrators to enforce unified data protection policies across AI interactions and collaborative features. This enables blocking sensitive information types in prompts and preventing labeled knowledge sources from being used in AI operations.

updates.title: CVE-2026-80092: Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Microsoft Identity Web versions 3 and 4 contain an elevation of privilege vulnerability affecting v3.16.0 and v4.16.1. Organizations should update to the specified security versions to remediate this risk in their authentication infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention Based on Last Accessed
updates.summary: Purview now supports applying retention labels and policies in OneDrive and SharePoint based on when files were last accessed by users. This capability enables more granular retention strategies aligned with actual data usage patterns.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies in Purview to automatically archive inactive SharePoint files to low-cost storage while maintaining compliance and discoverability. This extends data lifecycle management beyond keep-or-delete actions to include archiving workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager Integration with AI Foundry
updates.summary: Purview Compliance Manager now integrates with Microsoft AI Foundry to automatically map AI agents to compliance regulations and assess their compliance posture. This enables organizations to evaluate compliance controls for AI agents and identify improvement actions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: SDK Embedded in Agent Framework
updates.summary: The Purview SDK is now integrated into the Agent Framework SDK, enabling developers to embed security and compliance controls directly into AI agents they build. This integration automatically classifies sensitive data, prevents data leaks, and provides audit visibility for regulated AI deployments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP General Availability for FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now monitors and restricts sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols in general availability. Security teams can configure transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration across these file transfer channels.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access (General Availability)
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms. This integration enforces restrictive actions and detects risky user activity while preventing data loss to untrusted cloud services.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new compliance report for Information Barriers policies helps administrators identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes. This visibility tool simplifies monitoring and remediation of barrier violations.
